originality.rationale: Motivating 2026 Proposition 2 leaves its guaranteed descent coefficient zero at q=sigma_g; here the sharp dimension-free value 1/2 is proved for all centered bounded errors. The subthreshold deadzone is expressly prior art from Chen et al. 2020; the new result is the sharp endpoint uniform bound and its threshold conclusion. Other inspected primary work uses symmetry or bounded variance and does not imply the new endpoint statement. Historical equivalent remains possible.

value.rationale: A natural algorithmic control parameter q is identified sharply at the noise-support radius sigma. The motivating 2026 method requires q>sigma for strictly positive theoretical coefficient and only guarantees half-coefficient at q>=2sigma; the endpoint q=sigma formerly yields zero in its inequality, whereas the new universal factor 1/2 is optimal. This structurally closes the narrowest reliable radius gap for stochastic clipping and clarifies the strict distinction with the known subthreshold flat-drift regime.
